description: You have messy sleep diary notes in /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/sleep_notes_raw.txt covering 2 weeks. Create an organized spreadsheet named 'sleep_analysis.xlsx' in the same directory with columns for Date, Bedtime, Wake Time, Times Awoke, Sleep Quality, Total Hours in Bed (calculated), Caffeine After Noon (Yes/No), Exercise Minutes, Screen Time Hours, and Stress Level. Enter all 14 days of data and calculate summary statistics: average sleep quality overall, average quality on no-afternoon-caffeine days, average quality on exercise 30+ min days, average quality on screen time ≤1hr days, and overall average hours in bed. Use formulas for calculations.
